title: 06 Oct 2026: Yields Ease, Jobs Cool, Micron Surges
summary: US equities reached fresh highs as yields and oil eased, but bond-market risks remain central for UK investors. This week also covers softer US payrolls, revised UK growth, Micron’s exceptional AI-memory results, Nike’s early-stage turnaround, and the key events ahead.
